visual_reference.reference_title: machi cold brew cafe landing page

image_to_code_analysis.card_structure: Deconstructed from Dribbble shot & Machi reference: rounded-3xl (24px) soft cards with borderless pastel fills (#FCE4D6 peach, #E2EFDA matcha, #FFF2CC mango, #F8CECC berry), light 1px border (#F3F4F6) only on white elevated surfaces with soft ambient drop shadow shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(100,181,246,0.15)].
image_to_code_analysis.badge_and_accents: Status pill tags with rounded-full geometry, dual-tone contrast (sky-100/sky-800 for Dipesan, amber-100/amber-800 for Disiapkan, emerald-100/emerald-800 for Siap Diambil, gray-100/gray-700 for Selesai), clean emoji accents, zero decorative clutter.
image_to_code_analysis.typography_hierarchy: Plus Jakarta Sans bold/extrabold (700/800/900) for high-character display headings & giant 'boash' wordmark footer, paired with clean tabular/system Inter (400/500/600) for order metadata, pricing, and operational telemetry.

layout.concept: Unified multi-page ecosystem: breezy sky-blue atmospheric landing (index.html) with giant 'boash' wordmark; clean focused ordering catalog (menu.html) with floating cart summary; reassuring live order status tracker (status.html); and a dedicated modern cafe POS merchant portal (penjual.html) with clean live queue boards and real-time revenue cards.

layout.alignment: Left-aligned editorial typography on wide desktop grid, with centered floating hero focal elements and balanced multi-column product card distribution.
layout.alignment_rationale: Left-aligned editorial typography provides immediate scannability for fast school break ordering and kitchen queue management, while centered hero and wordmark bookends create brand gravitas.

principles: Kantin Boash unites student refreshment and canteen vendor management under a cohesive Japanese-Italian boutique coffee identity (machi). By separating user flows into dedicated pages (landing, ordering, live tracking, and merchant POS), cognitive load is minimized while every screen maintains crisp contrast, pastel warmth, and tactile clarity.

orchestrated_moment.trigger: Page-specific focal moments: hero cup float on landing, cart drawer slide-out on menu, status badge pulse on tracking, and order ticket entrance on merchant portal
orchestrated_moment.justification: Exactly ONE deliberate motion moment per page prevents animation noise while providing immediate sensory feedback for critical user transitions.

token_overrides.border_radius: rounded-3xl (24px) for cards and modals, rounded-full for pills, rounded-2xl for dashboard tiles
token_overrides.spacing: Generous py-16 to py-24 section gutters, 4/8dp spatial grid inside cards
token_overrides.palette: Custom sky atmosphere (#64B5F6 to #FFFFFF) and machi pastels overriding default slate/gray primitives
